messages:
alisa: Quick heads-up — preparing FP8 kernel enablement for atlas-13b across H100 and L40S. Want a short onboarding + canary checklist before we flip traffic. Observed small but consistent deltas on long-prefix QA (loss +0.7% on a 2k prefix sample). Anyone have a concise set of gates we can run? :thinking:

ben: +1. We should capture perf (tokens/s), p50/p95 latency, mem usage, and loss/quality deltas. Also need clear rollback triggers. Can you paste the long-prefix test that showed the +0.7%?

alisa: Pasted a tiny excerpt of the test results below (sanitized):
```
config: fp8-default on H100
long_prefix_eval: loss=2.87
same-run fp16 baseline: loss=2.85
delta = +0.02 (~0.7%)
throughput = 12600 tokens/s
latency_p95 = 84ms
```
Not catastrophic but curious about amplification on evicted KV scenarios.

carmen: Thanks. A couple practical notes from runtime: FP8 on L40S uses a different tiling handshake which can increase small batch p95 by ~10–15ms. Also watch kv-cache eviction hotspots for long contexts — those are where numeric drift surfaces.

carmen: Suggested minimal canary checklist (draft):
1) Run microbench: throughput, p50/p95, mem, GPU util on H100 and L40S.
2) Run short-file regression suite (1–2k tokens) and long-prefix suite (2k–8k). Capture loss delta + sample-wise BLEU/ROUGE where applicable.
3) Shadow traffic for 1 hour at 5% traffic, compare token-level logprobs and perplexity distributions.
4) Run KV eviction stress: repeated long-prefix requests to provoke evictions.
5) Canary config with 3 variants: fp8-default (new), fp8-stable (with clamp), and baseline-fp16.
6) Observe and enforce rollback if: avg loss delta > 1.5% across eval suite OR p95 latency regression > 20% OR error rate increase > 0.5%.

ben: Love that. Can you give an example canary routing config we can drop into the console for automated comparison?

carmen: Sure, here's a trimmed canary route we used for prior rollouts — should be portable: 
```yaml
route: /v1/generate
variants:
  - name: baseline-fp16
    weight: 80
  - name: fp8-default
    weight: 10
  - name: fp8-stable
    weight: 10
policies:
  metric_checks:
    - name: loss_delta
      compare_against: baseline-fp16
      threshold: 0.015   # 1.5%
    - name: p95_latency_ratio
      compare_against: baseline-fp16
      threshold: 1.20   # 20%
    - name: error_rate_delta
      threshold: 0.005  # 0.5%
fallback: baseline-fp16
notify: # webhook to #eng-oncall
  - url: https://hooks.redwood.local/canary-alerts
```

dinesh: A few practical tips from eval side:
- Use sample-wise KL and median loss, not just mean — FP8 can create heavy tails.
- Compute BLEU/ROC on targeted slices (e.g., code-gen, instruction-following, translations). Small mean deltas can mask large slice regressions.
- Keep an eyeball set: 50 random examples from shadow traffic every 10 mins (manual review). :eyes:

alisa: Great — for observability, what dashboard widgets should we pin?

ben: Minimum dashboard:
- throughput (tokens/s) by variant
- p50/p95 latency by variant
- rolling mean loss delta and median loss delta by variant
- error rate and 5xxs by variant
- sample KL histogram (bucketed)
- top N prompts with largest delta (link to replay)

canary-bot: Canary started: route=/v1/generate, fp8-default=10%, fp8-stable=10%, baseline-fp16=80% at 2026-03-20T15:00:00Z. Monitoring window: 60m.

alisa: Starting shadow run now on H100 + L40S. Will post initial perf numbers in ~30m. If anyone wants to add more automated slices, ping me.

carmen: One more: when measuring quant variants (FP8 vs AWQ vs GPTQ), expose quantization metadata in the response header so downstream logging can attribute quality deltas precisely. e.g., `X-Quant-Variant: fp8-stable`

dinesh: Also recommend precomputed regression prompts targeting known failure modes: long-chain dependencies, code indent preservation, numeric tables. These are where FP8 has surprised us historically.

alisa: Action items:
- carmen: finalize canary route + header attribution (today)
- ben: dashboard + alert hooks (today)
- dinesh: pick and upload eval slices + failure prompts (this afternoon)
- alisa: run shadow on H100/L40S and report back with logs

carmen: ack. I’ll add the clamp profile to `fp8-stable` (small activation clamp + per-channel scale tweak) and post the exact model artifact hash.

ben: :thumbsup: Ready to roll when hashes are posted.

alisa: Thanks all — will paste results once the 1hr window completes. :rocket:
